story.title: A stronger community starts with showing up.
story.intro: Unity Within is a youth-led mental health organization. We want every young person to feel heard, supported, and safely connected to more help when they need it.

what.title: Small moments of care. A more connected campus.
what.intro: We build practical, compassionate ways for young people to support one another while understanding the boundaries of peer support.
what.imageAlt: A crowd gathered together in community

training.title: You don't need every answer to learn how to listen.
training.intro: Training helps peer supporters practise listening, healthy boundaries, and when to connect someone to qualified professional support.
training.imageAlt: People seated together at a community gathering

support.title: You deserve to be heard.
support.intro: A peer-support conversation can offer a caring first step. Unity Within is not emergency treatment, crisis care, counselling, or a substitute for professional medical care.

hub.title: There is no one right way to be you.
hub.intro: A gentle corner for reflection, self-kindness, and finding community at your own pace.
hub.imageAlt: A group sharing a moment together outdoors

stories.title: Stories belong to the people who share them.
stories.intro: We only publish personal stories when the contributor has explicitly agreed. You can still share a story privately and choose exactly how, or whether, it appears.
stories.imageAlt: People listening to one another at a gathering

impact.title: Measure what matters. Share only what we can verify.
impact.intro: Trust grows with honest reporting. We share verified activity, learn from our community, and avoid overstating what a young movement can do.

events.title: Find your people. Make space for honest conversation.
events.intro: We are building thoughtful opportunities to learn, connect, and make campus feel a little less lonely.
events.imageAlt: People taking part in a group conversation

volunteer.title: You can make room for someone to be heard.
volunteer.intro: Peer supporters learn together, receive guidance, and make thoughtful space for students to connect to the help they need.
volunteer.imageAlt: A crowd of young people coming together

partner.title: Build safer support, together.
partner.intro: We welcome experienced mentors, counsellors, educators, and organisations who can help young people find safe, thoughtful peer support.

donate.title: Help a young idea grow responsibly.
donate.intro: We are preparing transparent ways to support peer training and wellbeing resources. Verified giving details will appear here when they are ready.

resources.title: A few caring, practical starting points.
resources.intro: These resources support listening and connection. They are educational information, not diagnosis or treatment.

contact.title: Start a thoughtful conversation.
contact.intro: Reach the Unity Within team about peer support, volunteering, collaboration, or ways to make campus feel more connected.

faq.question: Do I need experience to volunteer?
faq.answer: No. Peer supporters take part in training and receive guidance. We do not expect students to act as counsellors or handle complex situations alone.

faq.question: Is peer support professional treatment?
faq.answer: No. Peer support offers connection and listening. It is not counselling, professional medical care, or emergency support.

faq.question: Where can I get help in an emergency?
faq.answer: Unity Within is not an emergency service. Please contact local emergency services or a qualified health professional.

faq.question: Can I share a story anonymously?
faq.answer: Stories are unpublished by default. We only publish a story with explicit consent, and identifying details must not be shared without the contributor's permission.
